feedback_history.therapist_response: I’ve been thinking a lot about the anxiety I get when I eat—especially now that I’m back on fluoxetine. It’s not just a small spike; it’s like a wave comes over me, full-body, tight and shaky, like I’m suddenly scared I’ll lose control. I used to think the medication would calm that down, especially since I struggled with eating anxiety before. But it hasn’t helped much. I’m not sure if it’s the meds, or if I’m just still carrying that old fear. I feel kind of stuck—like I’m trying to eat normally, but every bite feels like it’s triggering something I can’t quite name. I guess I just want to know if there’s a way to get past this, without making it worse.
